induction h using AddConGen.Rel.induction on a b
case refl => exact hr a b h
case add c d e f hc hd he hf => 
  have h1 : AddConGen.Rel r c e := by induction hc using AddConGen.Rel.induction on c e
  have h2 : AddConGen.Rel r d f := by induction hd using AddConGen.Rel.induction on d f
  have h3 : AddConGen.Rel r (star c) (star e) := by induction h1 using AddConGen.Rel.induction on c e
  have h4 : AddConGen.Rel r (star d) (star f) := by induction h2 using AddConGen.Rel.induction on d f
  exact AddConGen.Rel.add h3 h4
